scoring_semantics: CREST-equivalent MEOL membership path: selected operators contribute to local/denoised CREST energy; mutation and propagation memberships only choose dynamic counterfactual explain-away sets.

operators.name: meol::metric_max_z
operators.rationale: Large metric z shifts provide local evidence but are neutral for counterfactual mutation/propagation explain-away.

operators.name: meol::metric_count_drop_shift
operators.rationale: A sharp drop in service metric observations can indicate stopped processing or reporting.

operators.name: meol::trace_status_code_shift
operators.rationale: A status-code distribution shift reflects interface behavior changes at service granularity.

operators.name: meol::trace_error_rate
operators.rationale: A change in error status rate is a compact interface failure signal.

operators.name: meol::trace_endpoint_shift
operators.rationale: A changed endpoint mix suggests altered service interface behavior.

operators.name: meol::trace_duration_delta
operators.rationale: Latency shifts are often amplified along dependencies and are treated primarily as propagated symptoms.

operators.name: meol::trace_count_rise_shift
operators.rationale: A trace count rise can reflect retries, fan-out, or propagated pressure.

operators.name: meol::trace_count_drop_shift
operators.mechanism: service hang or request handling failure
operators.rationale: A sharp trace activity drop can indicate stopped request handling.

operators.name: meol::log_count_delta
operators.rationale: Log volume changes can indicate local software events or propagated error handling.

operators.name: meol::log_template_delta
operators.rationale: A log-template distribution shift indicates changed software behavior that can be local or propagated.
